page.overview:
What is Grapnel?

The Grapnel was a starship captained by Wan'yek Whett and crewed by a fishing crew.

The Grapnel was described by former first mate Skoova Stev as being large and sharp like the nose of a bony fish, and as having three claw-like legs for landing gear.

While the precise origins of the ship are unknown, the Grapnel was stolen from an unknown location and owner by the Besalisk Dread Captain Wan'yek Whett and his vile fishing crew, to serve as their spaceship and fishing vessel.

During the time of the Great Fish Famine, the Grapnel landed on the icy world of Sakavi Tar. With the crew intending to plunder the vast oceans underneath the planet's icy surface, a Sakavian fisherman named Skoova Stev struck a deal with Whett to join his crew on the Grapnel and lend him his fishing expertise, on the condition that they not fish on his starving homeworld. Whett agreed, and the Grapnel departed from Sakavi Tar with its' new crew member.
